text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Tiara route, the 
Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ramonu challenging for the 
second crown of the Triple Tiara route, 
the crowd felt even larger than at last 
year's Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa,
so many people! I wonder if I'll be 
able to see Lady Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I just "see" her, I can't 
help looking! Ramonu-sama is practically 
radiant, after all!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: Look, just like that...—

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! I-Is that the real Lady 
Ramonu...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It is truly wonderful weather, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, uh, ah-eh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Today... is going to be a wonderful race.

text_block_list.text: Yes. Please—look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I... I actually talked to her. With 
Ramonu-sama...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"...Lady Ramonu's brilliance... is 
truly... amazing, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, of course I do! Because... she's the 
one who will claim the first-ever Triple 
Tiara—!"

text_block_list.text: —Oh, my... Cold sweat.

text_block_list.text:

mostly at a mile or less through the 
Junior Class and the Oka Sho,
the distance 
suddenly jumps up quite a bit.
choice_data_list: The Oaks is at a distance you don'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speed has been the deciding factor up to 
now, but the Oaks will demand stamina on 
top of that. Still, the same goes for all 
the other girls...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How to run the long home stretch that is 
so characteristic of Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.text: Right? Are we done now?

text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse had course renovations
in 
the past, slightly shifting the finish 
line's position. Of course, we're 
practicing with that in mind, but—
choice_data_list: Right before the finish line, dig ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Diligent in her studies, she has watched 
past footage until it's burned into her 
memory. That intuition might just make a 
subtle difference...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It must be necessary to remain perfect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everything is in place. Now...
to the land 
I hold dear—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text: âRamonu... san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race...
The one who spoke 
to me was a fellow Umamusume from the
same 
generation who had raced Mejiro Ramonu 
several times before.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text: "...Do you have just a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to spring this on you so 
suddenly. But...
I don't really understand 
it myself, yet I just felt like I had to 
tell you...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text:
"You surely don't truly know me.
...You've 
never seen the real me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text:
...! But I've... grown stronger. Way, way 
stronger since then!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I challenge you. —I will not 
yield the Oaks...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text: ...T-That's all. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting. For that bloodlust...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I take it I may consider you a snake as 
well?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it was just a frog... accidentally 
jumping in...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: In a single bite.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White...
text_block_list.text:
...Nghh!! Wh-what a person... E-Excuse 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
She is strong in the face of adversity... 
All that's left is your own grit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Their driving force, aiming for me with 
all their might—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It drives me toward victory. ...Now, let 
us add the second crown.
